extracted.name: Fruity Fun Skewers
extracted.description: A fun, beautiful, and distinctive way to serve fruit at your next party! Try these fruit skewers out with a variety of fruit dips to make them even more exciting.
ingredient_lines: 0.25 cantaloupe, cut into balls or cubes
2 bananas, peeled and cut into chunks
instruction_lines: Thread strawberries, cantaloupe, banana, and apple pieces alternately onto skewers, placing at least 2 pieces of fruit on each skewer. Arrange skewers decoratively on a serving platter.
